name: Mad Science Love
original_name: マッドサイエンス・ラヴ
source:
Who would like to spend days with "normal" girls if there is an option? All kinds of special girls like cat ears, drill, amphibian etc fight with each other and grow up under supervision of a mad scientist.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-august-2001-kimi-ga-nozomu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
既然还有别的选择，谁愿意整天和“普通”少女相处？猫耳少女、钻头少女、两栖少女等形形色色的特殊少女彼此争斗，并在一名疯狂科学家的监督下成长。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-august-2001-kimi-ga-nozomu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
